adaptations: Rewrote MMSA absolute imports in MSALM, MMGPT, and BI_ENC to vendor.bcmlf package-relative imports.
Replaced the upstream singleTask package initializer, which eagerly imported models and trainers outside the copied closure, with an inert initializer.
Made MSALM task and branch output dimensions configurable via task_out while preserving default task_out=1.
Added identical [B,C] branch-shape validation for scalar or five-class output.
Required local-only GPT model/tokenizer loading; removed automatic online fallback.
Added the upstream BI_ENC model class and rewrote its MMSA imports to the vendored package.
Made AV_Enc checkpoint loading strict, CPU-mapped, and weights_only; missing keys and shape mismatches fail.
Added a five-class CE adapter that preserves BC soft-contrastive loss and restores the configured shifted/masked CLM auxiliary loss with gamma.
Added a recursive repository-relative root resolver for data, local GPT, and BI_ENC checkpoint paths.
